A research catch-up from my team at StoneComms.

The missing span
Africa is joining national grids into regional power systems. The next test is whether electricity can move through them reliably, be paid for, and reach the people and firms whose demand justified the investment. StoneComms examines the missing span between an interconnector's completion and a functioning market.
